retrievalLog.query: brief mindfulness intervention student wellbeing effect size
retrievalLog.rationale: No web retrieval tool is available in this build, so the comparator search could not be performed. Recorded as not performable rather than invented.

comparators.citation: Reference [12] in the manuscript reports a comparable brief-intervention effect in a student sample.
comparators.relevance: Provides an internal benchmark for the reported 0.42 SD effect without external retrieval.

gapMap: The manuscript positions itself against school-based programmes but does not situate the effect against the broader brief-intervention literature, which the authors can supply.
biasStatement: Without external retrieval the comparator base is limited to the manuscript's own references, which may over-represent supportive findings.

benchmarks.tension: The reported 0.42 SD is larger than the internal benchmark and warrants scrutiny.

sourceAvailability.summary: Preregistration link cited in the manuscript could not be verified in this build.

findings.claim: The reported effect exceeds the manuscript's own internal benchmark for brief interventions.
findings.failureScenario: An unexplained above-benchmark effect can signal an analysis or measurement artefact rather than a real gain.
findings.leanestFix: Situate the 0.42 SD effect against comparable brief-intervention studies and discuss why it is larger.

selfCritique.strongestObjection: With no external retrieval, the benchmark rests only on the manuscript's own references, which may over-represent supportive effects and understate the true comparator range.
confidenceRaisers: A live search of the brief-intervention literature to anchor the 0.42 SD effect against an independent benchmark.
